The '''Dobo Brothers' Emporium''' was a store based on [[Telos IV]]'s [[Citadel Station]] after the [[Jedi Civil War]]. It was divided in half, and customers could choose to buy items from [[Dendis Dobo|Dendis]], who was an honest merchant, or [[Samhan Dobo|Samhan]], who was a swindler and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] brothers had a rivalry with each other and often competed for customers. During their stay on the [[Space station/Legends|station]], the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] and her companions may have purchased items from the emporium.

==Behind the scenes==
The red sign outside the store above the doorway reads "MERCHANT" in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].
